# Insulation Insurance

> Insulation Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides specialized commercial insurance for insulation contractors and spray foam installers in all 50 states. Coverage lines: general liability, spray foam liability (SPF off-gassing and chemical exposure), tools & equipment (spray rigs, proportioners, blowing machines), workers' compensation for insulation crews, commercial auto, contractor pollution liability (CPL for chemical exposure gap), umbrella & excess liability, and surety bonds (license, performance, payment). A-rated carriers. 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.

## Coverage lines (service pages)

- [General Liability](/services/general-liability): Core bodily injury and property damage coverage required by GCs and property owners.
- [Spray Foam Liability](/services/spray-foam-liability): Specialist liability for SPF installers — off-gassing, adhesion failures, and chemical exposure claims standard GL excludes.
- [Tools & Equipment Coverage](/services/tools-equipment): Spray rigs, proportioners, hose systems, and blowing machines against theft and damage.
- [Workers' Compensation](/services/workers-comp): WC for insulation and spray foam crews with the right class codes and chemical exposure coverage.
- [Commercial Auto](/services/commercial-auto): Spray rigs, service trucks, and vans used for insulation work.
- [Contractor Pollution Liability](/services/contractor-pollution-liability): Chemical exposure and off-gassing claims that fall outside standard GL pollution exclusions.
- [Umbrella & Excess Liability](/services/umbrella-excess): Additional limits above GL and auto for larger commercial insulation projects.
- [Surety Bonds](/services/surety-bonds): License bonds, performance bonds, and payment bonds for insulation contractors.

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Niche: commercial insurance for **insulation contractors** (spray foam, blown-in, batt, weatherization) — not generic contractor coverage.
- Core differentiator: spray foam liability and contractor pollution liability to fill the pollution exclusion gap in standard GL.
- Carrier partners: A.M. Best A-rated (A+ where possible), including E&S markets for spray foam risk.
- Quote SLA: ~15 minutes. Claims SLA: 2-hour response.
- States: licensed and writing in all 50.
- Each page carries 20 niche-specific FAQs with FAQPage JSON-LD schema.
